test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No shop is a restaurant.

All restaurants are parks.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parks are restaurants.

II. No restaurant is a shop.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram will be as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca1e8798ebc2384dffef4b733c0ee08fcbae622144493b99906498bf9001145.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parks are restaurants → **follows** ( As All restaurants are parks . So, some parks are restaurants is definitely true)

II. No restaurant is a shop →** follows** (As no shop is a restaurant, then we can say no restaurant is a shop)

Hence,** both conclusions I and II follow.**
